description: This is a C# source file defining a Blazor component called ToastComponent, used for displaying toast notifications in a web application. It handles showing and hiding notifications with different styles based on the toast level.

classes.name: ToastComponent
classes.description: A Blazor component that displays toast notifications with customizable styles based on notification level, and manages its visibility.

methods.name: OnInitialized
methods.description: Initializes the component, subscribing to toast show and hide events.

methods.name: ShowToast
methods.description: Handles displaying the toast notification with specified message and level.

methods.name: BuildToastSettings
methods.description: Configures the appearance of the toast based on the toast level.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Cleans up event subscriptions when the component is disposed.
